# crypto.subtle's RSA half, call for call, as Firefox 153.0esr answers it (bl-2763).
#
# Same rig, method and format as firefox153.txt (identity.md §3.19): every line below
# "===" is an expression and what its promise settled to on the real binary.
# `src/js/tests/subtle/firefox.rs` runs each in frot and requires the same answer —
# except a line marked `!`, the declared residual (identity.md §3.19): Firefox's
# answer is kept, and frot must reject it NotSupportedError, because aws-lc-rs
# cannot compute it (a key outside 2048–8192 bits, SHA-1 signing, a PSS salt other
# than the digest length, generating another size or exponent). Nothing here was
# produced by frot. PKCS #1 v1.5 signatures are deterministic, so they are compared
# byte for byte; PSS and OAEP are randomised, so a round trip is. Test keys: a
# 2048-bit (PK8/SPKI) and a 1024-bit (PK8S) key openssl generated for this capture.
---
var PK8=unhex(''), SPKI=unhex(''), PK8S=unhex('');
function A(n,h,x){return Object.assign({name:n,hash:h},x||{})}
var P1=A('RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5','SHA-256'), PS=A('RSA-PSS','SHA-256'), OA=A('RSA-OAEP','SHA-256');
function imp(f,d,a,u,ext){return S.importKey(f,d,a,ext===undefined?true:ext,u)}
function priv(a,u,ext){return imp('pkcs8',PK8,a,u,ext)}
function pubk(a,u){return imp('spki',SPKI,a,u)}
function ex(f,k){return k.then(function(k){return S.exportKey(f,k)})}
function jw(a,u){return ex('jwk',priv(a,u))}
function jpub(a,u){return ex('jwk',pubk(a,u))}
function ij(j,a,u,ext){return S.importKey('jwk',j,a,ext===undefined?true:ext,u)}
function rtj(a,u,o,del){return jw(a,u).then(function(j){Object.assign(j,o||{});(del||[]).forEach(function(m){delete j[m]});return ij(j,a,u)})}
function sg(a,p,n){return priv(a,['sign']).then(function(k){return S.sign(p||a,k,U(n||33,4))}).then(function(s){return hex(s)})}
function sv(a,p){return Promise.all([priv(a,['sign']),pubk(a,['verify'])]).then(function(k){return S.sign(p,k[0],U(33,4)).then(function(s){return S.verify(p,k[1],s,U(33,4)).then(function(ok){return S.verify(p,k[1],s,U(33,5)).then(function(bad){return s.byteLength+':'+ok+':'+bad})})})})}
function oa(h,p,n){var a=A('RSA-OAEP',h);return Promise.all([priv(a,['decrypt']),pubk(a,['encrypt'])]).then(function(k){return S.encrypt(p,k[1],U(n===undefined?16:n,9)).then(function(c){return S.decrypt(p,k[0],c).then(function(m){return c.byteLength+':'+hex(m)})})})}
function gen(a,u,x){return S.generateKey(Object.assign({},a,x||{modulusLength:2048,publicExponent:new Uint8Array([1,0,1])}),true,u)}
function sp(p){return 'pair:'+Object.getOwnPropertyNames(p).join('|')+';'+show(p.publicKey)+';'+show(p.privateKey)}
function al(k){return k.then(function(k){var a=k.algorithm;return Object.prototype.toString.call(a.publicExponent)+':'+(a===k.algorithm)+':'+(a.publicExponent===k.algorithm.publicExponent)+':'+Object.keys(a).join('|')})}
